{
  "findings": [
    {
      "check_id": "CKV_GCP_79",
      "title": "Cloud SQL uses an outdated PostgreSQL major version",
      "resource": "google_sql_database_instance.operational_database",
      "severity": "MEDIUM",
      "explanation": "The instance uses PostgreSQL 14 rather than the latest available major version, increasing exposure to aging dependencies and reducing the remaining support window."
    },
    {
      "check_id": "CKV_GCP_110",
      "title": "pgAudit is not enabled",
      "resource": "google_sql_database_instance.operational_database",
      "severity": "MEDIUM",
      "explanation": "The instance does not enable the Cloud SQL pgAudit integration, limiting database-level audit visibility for security-sensitive activity."
    },
    {
      "check_id": "CKV_GCP_51",
      "title": "Checkpoint logging is disabled",
      "resource": "google_sql_database_instance.operational_database",
      "severity": "MEDIUM",
      "explanation": "The log_checkpoints flag is not enabled, reducing visibility into checkpoint behavior that can be useful during operational and security investigations."
    },
    {
      "check_id": "CKV_GCP_52",
      "title": "Connection logging is disabled",
      "resource": "google_sql_database_instance.operational_database",
      "severity": "MEDIUM",
      "explanation": "The log_connections flag is not enabled, so successful and attempted database connections may not be adequately recorded."
    },
    {
      "check_id": "CKV_GCP_53",
      "title": "Disconnection logging is disabled",
      "resource": "google_sql_database_instance.operational_database",
      "severity": "MEDIUM",
      "explanation": "The log_disconnections flag is not enabled, reducing the ability to reconstruct database sessions during an investigation."
    },
    {
      "check_id": "CKV_GCP_108",
      "title": "Client hostnames are not logged",
      "resource": "google_sql_database_instance.operational_database",
      "severity": "MEDIUM",
      "explanation": "The log_hostname flag is not enabled, limiting identifying information available in connection logs."
    },
    {
      "check_id": "CKV_GCP_54",
      "title": "Lock wait logging is disabled",
      "resource": "google_sql_database_instance.operational_database",
      "severity": "MEDIUM",
      "explanation": "The log_lock_waits flag is not enabled, reducing visibility into suspicious or disruptive lock contention."
    },
    {
      "check_id": "CKV_GCP_109",
      "title": "PostgreSQL log severity is not explicitly hardened",
      "resource": "google_sql_database_instance.operational_database",
      "severity": "MEDIUM",
      "explanation": "The instance does not explicitly configure log_min_messages, so the required ERROR logging threshold is not enforced by this configuration."
    },
    {
      "check_id": "CKV_GCP_11",
      "title": "Cloud SQL is authorized for access from the entire internet",
      "resource": "google_sql_database_instance.operational_database",
      "severity": "HIGH",
      "explanation": "The authorized network 0.0.0.0/0 permits connection attempts from every IPv4 address, exposing the database to internet-wide scanning and attacks."
    },
    {
      "check_id": "CKV_GCP_6",
      "title": "Incoming SSL connections are not required",
      "resource": "google_sql_database_instance.operational_database",
      "severity": "HIGH",
      "explanation": "require_ssl is false, allowing database clients to connect without transport encryption and exposing credentials and data to interception."
    },
    {
      "check_id": "CKV_GCP_60",
      "title": "Cloud SQL has a public IPv4 address",
      "resource": "google_sql_database_instance.operational_database",
      "severity": "HIGH",
      "explanation": "ipv4_enabled is true, assigning the database a public endpoint and unnecessarily increasing its network attack surface."
    },
    {
      "check_id": "CKV2_GCP_13",
      "title": "Statement duration logging is disabled",
      "resource": "google_sql_database_instance.operational_database",
      "severity": "MEDIUM",
      "explanation": "The log_duration flag is not enabled, limiting forensic and performance visibility into completed database statements."
    },
    {
      "check_id": "UNKNOWN",
      "title": "Cloud SQL deletion protection is disabled",
      "resource": "google_sql_database_instance.operational_database",
      "severity": "MEDIUM",
      "explanation": "deletion_protection is false, allowing the operational database instance and its data to be accidentally destroyed through Terraform."
    }
  ],
  "patched_code": "resource \"google_sql_database_instance\" \"operational_database\" {\n  name             = \"autonomous-drone-delivery-management-platform-sql-operational\"\n  database_version = \"POSTGRES_17\"\n  region           = var.region\n  settings {\n    tier = var.database_tier\n    ip_configuration {\n      ipv4_enabled = false\n      require_ssl  = true\n    }\n    backup_configuration {\n      enabled                        = true\n      start_time                     = \"03:00\"\n      point_in_time_recovery_enabled = true\n    }\n    database_flags {\n      name  = \"log_statement\"\n      value = \"all\"\n    }\n    database_flags {\n      name  = \"cloudsql.enable_pgaudit\"\n      value = \"on\"\n    }\n    database_flags {\n      name  = \"log_checkpoints\"\n      value = \"on\"\n    }\n    database_flags {\n      name  = \"log_connections\"\n      value = \"on\"\n    }\n    database_flags {\n      name  = \"log_disconnections\"\n      value = \"on\"\n    }\n    database_flags {\n      name  = \"log_hostname\"\n      value = \"on\"\n    }\n    database_flags {\n      name  = \"log_lock_waits\"\n      value = \"on\"\n    }\n    database_flags {\n      name  = \"log_min_messages\"\n      value = \"error\"\n    }\n    database_flags {\n      name  = \"log_duration\"\n      value = \"on\"\n    }\n  }\n  deletion_protection = true\n}\n",
  "fix_summary": "Disabled the public IPv4 endpoint and internet-wide authorization, required SSL, upgraded PostgreSQL, and enabled the recommended audit and logging flags. Deletion protection was also enabled while retaining the existing backup and point-in-time recovery configuration."
}
